sources.title: FLUX.1-merged: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: The drbaph merge targets higher quality at 4 steps through block-level fine-tuning of the merge ratios and adds fp8 quantization for smaller model size, while FLUX.1-merged prioritizes simplicity and bfloat16 precision.

sources.title: CivArchive - CivitAI Archive
sources.snippet: CivArchive is a cross-platform search engine for AI models. We don't host files ourselves — instead, we crawl various sources and index the models we find, using the file's SHA256 hash as its unique, permanent ID.
